answer: Sybil gate: every new identity locks 180 POA for 36 epochs and must answer a live violet-channel pulse signed by a randomly drawn raven auditor within 2 hours of join. Clones fail because the auditor binds the live key; 6,000 fakes need about 1,080,000 POA locked (assumed 180 each). Limitation: auditor scarcity can delay honest joins during floods.
